headline: One-Third of Public Concessions in Peru Scheduled to Expire by 2035
summary: Private investment promotion agency ProInversión reported that one-third of public infrastructure concessions in Peru will reach contract expiration by 2035, prompting evaluation of re-tendering terms.
why: Infrastructure concessions govern Peruvian highways, ports, and utilities. Contract renewals determine long-term capital expenditure terms and private sector operator returns.
